<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a0a" />
<title>Optiline — Business Development</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Michroma&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<style>
  :root{--bg:#0a0a0a;--panel:#141414;--panel-2:#1b1b1b;--line:#2a2a2a;--red:#E1251B;--red-soft:rgba(225,37,27,.16);--red-glow:rgba(225,37,27,.4);--white:#fff;--grey-4:#808080;--muted:#8b8b8b;--green:#3ec46d;--amber:#f2711c;}
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 85% -10%, rgba(225,37,27,.10), transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 500px at 100% -5%, rgba(225,37,27,.10), transparent 60%),var(--bg);background-attachment:fixed;color:var(--white);font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;}
  body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.05;z-index:0;background-image:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 46%,#fff 46%,#fff 49%,transparent 49%),linear-gradient(225deg,transparent 46%,#fff 46%,#fff 49%,transparent 49%);background-size:120px 120px;background-position:60px 0}
  .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(14px,1.6vw,28px) clamp(14px,2vw,40px) 46px}
  header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:clamp(14px,1.4vw,22px)}
  .titles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1}
  .logo{height:clamp(24px,1.9vw,38px);width:auto;align-self:flex-start;display:block;margin-bottom:7px}
  .kicker{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4em;font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,12px);color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px}
  h1{font-family:'Michroma';font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,34px);letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
  .clock{text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:flex-end}
  .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:clamp(9px,.7vw,11px);color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--red-soft);border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 12px}
  .live .pulse{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--red);animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
  .asof{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,12px);color:var(--grey-4);letter-spacing:.06em}
  .kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:clamp(8px,.9vw,14px);margin-bottom:clamp(12px,1.2vw,20px)}
  @media(max-width:1080px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
  @media(max-width:600px){.kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
  .kpi{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel),var(--panel-2));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:clamp(11px,1vw,17px) clamp(12px,1.1vw,18px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .kpi::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--red)}
  .kpi .kl{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(8.5px,.64vw,10.5px);color:var(--muted)}
  .kpi .kv{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,27px);line-height:1.05;margin:7px 0 3px}
  .kpi .ks{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(9px,.7vw,11.5px);color:var(--grey-4)}
  .kpi .kv .ar{font-size:.6em;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:3px}
  .up{color:var(--green)} .down{color:#ff5f53} .flat{color:var(--amber)}
  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:clamp(10px,1vw,16px)}
  .panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel),#0f0f0f);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:clamp(13px,1.1vw,20px);min-width:0}
  .c12{grid-column:span 12}.c8{grid-column:span 8}.c7{grid-column:span 7}.c6{grid-column:span 6}.c5{grid-column:span 5}.c4{grid-column:span 4}
  @media(max-width:1080px){.c8,.c7,.c6,.c5,.c4{grid-column:span 12}}
  .ptop{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .ptitle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px)}
  .ptitle .c{color:var(--red)}
  .pmeta{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(9px,.74vw,12px);color:var(--grey-4);letter-spacing:.04em;text-align:right}
  table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:clamp(11px,.86vw,13.5px)}
  th,td{padding:8px 10px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid #1c1c1c}
  th{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.82em;color:var(--muted)}
  td:first-child,th:first-child{text-align:left}
  td.v{font-family:'Michroma'} tbody tr:hover td{background:#181818}
  .tot td{color:var(--red);font-weight:700;font-family:'Michroma';border-top:2px solid var(--red)}
  .chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
  .gcrow{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
  .gcrow:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .gcrow .nm{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(11px,.86vw,13.5px);flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .gcrow .dt{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:.82em;color:var(--red);white-space:nowrap}
  .gcrow .rg{font-size:.8em;color:var(--grey-4);white-space:nowrap}
  footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-top:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .vline{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,15px);color:#dcdcdc}
  .vline .tenx{font-family:'Michroma';color:var(--red);margin-left:9px;text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red-glow)}
  .src{font-size:10px;color:#5a5a5a;letter-spacing:.04em}
  #funnel table{min-width:1180px;font-size:clamp(9px,.72vw,11.5px)}
  #funnel th,#funnel td{padding:6px 7px}
  #funnel td.tot,#funnel th.tot{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
  #funnel tr.pctrow td{color:var(--grey-4)}
  #funnel tr.pctrow td:first-child{color:#cfcfcf}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.25}}
  .ministrip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin-bottom:13px}
  .ms{background:#111;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 12px}
  .ms .l{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
  .ms .v{font-family:'Michroma';font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,22px);margin-top:5px;line-height:1.05}
  .ms .s{font-size:9px;color:var(--grey-4);margin-top:3px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <header>
    <div class="titles">
      <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Optiline">
      <span class="kicker">Optiline Enterprises</span>
      <h1>Business Development</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="clock">
      <span class="live"><span class="pulse"></span> Live</span>
      <span class="asof" id="asof">—</span>
    </div>
  </header>
  <section class="kpis" id="kpis"></section>
  <section class="grid">
    <div class="panel c8">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Submitted $ — Weekly</div><div class="pmeta">by submit date &middot; last 13 wks</div></div>
      <div id="oppChart"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c4">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>New GC Relationships — Weekly</div></div>
      <div id="gcChart"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c7">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Opportunity Creation by BD Manager</div><div class="pmeta">YTD</div></div>
      <div id="bdmTable"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c5">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Newest GC Relationships</div></div>
      <div id="newGc"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c7">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Opportunities by Region</div><div class="pmeta">YTD</div></div>
      <div id="regionTable"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c5">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Top GCs by Opportunity $</div><div class="pmeta">YTD</div></div>
      <div id="topGc"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c7">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Follow-up Activity</div><div class="pmeta" id="actMeta">daily 6am sync &middot; BasisBoard</div></div>
      <div id="actKpis" class="ministrip"></div>
      <div id="actTable"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c5">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>BD Validation Speed</div><div class="pmeta">created &rarr; validated &middot; YTD</div></div>
      <div id="bdvKpis" class="ministrip"></div>
      <div id="bdvChart"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel c12">
      <div class="ptop"><div class="ptitle"><span class="c">&#9650;</span>Bid Funnel — Monthly (by Bid Deadline)</div><div class="pmeta" id="funnelMeta">matches Bid Pace</div></div>
      <div style="overflow-x:auto"><div id="funnel"></div></div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <footer>
    <div class="vline">Creating Opportunity Through Growth.<span class="tenx">10X</span></div>
    <div class="src">Source: BasisBoard export (Basis Master)</div>
  </footer>
</div>
<script>
var DATA = <?!= data ?>;
const $=function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};
const fmtM=function(v){ if(v==null) return '—'; var a=Math.abs(v); if(a>=1e9) return '$'+(v/1e9).toFixed(2)+'B'; if(a>=1e6) return '$'+(v/1e6).toFixed(1)+'M'; if(a>=1e3) return '$'+Math.round(v/1e3)+'K'; return '$'+Math.round(v); };
const num=function(n){ return (n==null)?'—':Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); };
const esc=function(s){ return (s==null?'':String(s)); };

function kpis(){
  var k=DATA.kpi||{};
  var crUp = k.createdWk>=k.createdWkPrev;
  var subUp = k.subWkDol>=k.subWkDolPrev;
  var cards=[
    {l:'Opps Created — This Wk', v:num(k.createdWk), s:'vs '+num(k.createdWkPrev)+' last wk · wk '+esc(DATA.weekLabel), cls:(crUp?'up':'down'), ar:(crUp?'▲':'▼')},
    {l:'Opps Created YTD', v:num(k.createdYtd), s:'real pursued opportunities', cls:'', ar:''},
    {l:'Submitted $ — This Wk', v:fmtM(k.subWkDol), s:num(k.subWkN)+' bids submitted', cls:(subUp?'up':'down'), ar:(subUp?'▲':'▼')},
    {l:'Submitted $ 4-Wk Avg', v:fmtM(k.subAvg4Dol), s:'per week · YTD '+fmtM(k.subYtdDol), cls:'', ar:''},
    {l:'New GCs — This Wk', v:num(k.newGcWk), s:'4-wk avg '+(k.newGcAvg4!=null?k.newGcAvg4.toFixed(1):'—'), cls:(k.newGcWk>0?'up':''), ar:(k.newGcWk>0?'▲':'')},
    {l:'New GCs YTD', v:num(k.newGcYtd), s:num(k.activeGcYtd)+' active GCs bidding to us', cls:'', ar:''}
  ];
  $('kpis').innerHTML=cards.map(function(c){
    return '<div class="kpi"><div class="kl">'+c.l+'</div><div class="kv '+c.cls+'">'+(c.ar?'<span class="ar">'+c.ar+'</span>':'')+c.v+'</div><div class="ks">'+c.s+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}
function oppChart(){
  var d=DATA.weekly||[]; var W=820,H=250,padL=44,padR=12,padT=14,padB=40;
  var n=d.length, gw=(W-padL-padR)/Math.max(n,1);
  var max=Math.max.apply(null, d.map(function(x){return x.dol;}).concat([1]))*1.12;
  var y=function(v){ return padT+(H-padT-padB)*(1-v/max); };
  var g='';
  for(var t=0;t<=4;t++){ var gv=max*t/4, yy=y(gv); g+='<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+yy+'" x2="'+(W-padR)+'" y2="'+yy+'" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1"/>'; g+='<text x="'+(padL-6)+'" y="'+(yy+4)+'" fill="#666" font-size="10" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter">'+fmtM(gv)+'</text>'; }
  // 4-wk avg reference line
  var avg=DATA.kpi?DATA.kpi.subAvg4Dol:0; if(avg>0){ var ya=y(avg); g+='<line x1="'+padL+'" y1="'+ya+'" x2="'+(W-padR)+'" y2="'+ya+'" stroke="#c98a2e" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>'; g+='<text x="'+(W-padR)+'" y="'+(ya-5)+'" fill="#e0a64a" font-size="9.5" text-anchor="end" font-weight="700">4-wk avg '+fmtM(avg)+'</text>'; }
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var x0=padL+i*gw, bw=gw*0.62; var xb=x0+(gw-bw)/2; var hh=Math.max(0,(H-padB)-y(d[i].dol));
    g+='<rect x="'+xb+'" y="'+y(d[i].dol)+'" width="'+bw+'" height="'+hh+'" rx="2" fill="#E1251B"/>';
    if(d[i].n) g+='<text x="'+(x0+gw/2)+'" y="'+(y(d[i].dol)-4)+'" fill="#bbb" font-size="8.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter">'+d[i].n+'</text>';
    g+='<text x="'+(x0+gw/2)+'" y="'+(H-padB+15)+'" fill="#9a9a9a" font-size="9.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-weight="600">'+d[i].label+'</text>';
  }
  $('oppChart').innerHTML='<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">'+g+'</svg><div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left;margin-top:4px">Bar = submitted $ in that week (by submit date) · number above = # bids submitted</div>';
}

function gcChart(){
  var d=DATA.newGcWeekly||[]; var W=360,H=250,padL=24,padR=10,padT=14,padB=40;
  var n=d.length, gw=(W-padL-padR)/Math.max(n,1);
  var max=Math.max.apply(null, d.map(function(x){return x.n;}).concat([1]));
  var y=function(v){ return padT+(H-padT-padB)*(1-v/max); };
  var g='';
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var x0=padL+i*gw, bw=gw*0.6; var xb=x0+(gw-bw)/2; var hh=Math.max(0,(H-padB)-y(d[i].n));
    g+='<rect x="'+xb+'" y="'+y(d[i].n)+'" width="'+bw+'" height="'+hh+'" rx="2" fill="#607080"/>';
    if(d[i].n) g+='<text x="'+(x0+gw/2)+'" y="'+(y(d[i].n)-4)+'" fill="#bbb" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">'+d[i].n+'</text>';
    if(i%2===0) g+='<text x="'+(x0+gw/2)+'" y="'+(H-padB+15)+'" fill="#9a9a9a" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">'+d[i].label+'</text>';
  }
  $('gcChart').innerHTML='<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">'+g+'</svg><div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left;margin-top:4px">New GC relationships added per week</div>';
}

function bdmTable(){
  var d=DATA.byBdm||[];
  var body=d.map(function(r){ return '<tr><td>'+esc(r.name)+'</td><td class="v">'+num(r.createdN)+'</td><td class="v">'+fmtM(r.subDol)+'</td><td class="v">'+fmtM(r.subWk)+'</td></tr>'; }).join('');
  $('bdmTable').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>BD Manager</th><th>Opps Created YTD</th><th>Submitted $ YTD</th><th>This Wk $</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+body+'</tbody></table>';
}
function regionTable(){
  var d=DATA.byRegion||[];
  var body=d.map(function(r){ return '<tr><td>'+esc(r.region)+'</td><td class="v">'+num(r.createdN)+'</td><td class="v">'+fmtM(r.subDol)+'</td></tr>'; }).join('');
  $('regionTable').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>Region</th><th>Opps Created</th><th>Submitted $</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+body+'</tbody></table>';
}
function topGc(){
  var d=DATA.topGcs||[];
  var body=d.map(function(r){ return '<tr><td>'+esc(r.name)+'</td><td class="v">'+num(r.n)+'</td><td class="v">'+fmtM(r.dol)+'</td></tr>'; }).join('');
  $('topGc').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>GC</th><th>Opps</th><th>$ YTD</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+body+'</tbody></table>';
}
function newGc(){
  var d=DATA.newestGcs||[];
  $('newGc').innerHTML=d.map(function(r){ return '<div class="gcrow"><span class="nm">'+esc(r.name)+'</span><span class="rg">'+esc(r.region)+'</span><span class="dt">'+esc(r.when)+'</span></div>'; }).join('') || '<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left">No recent GCs</div>';
}

function activityPanel(){
  var a=DATA.activity||{}; var host=$('actTable'), ks=$('actKpis'), meta=$('actMeta');
  if(!a.available){
    var msg = (a.error==='no-sheet')
      ? 'Run the collector (bbSyncActivity) once to populate the BD_Reminders sheet.'
      : 'Follow-up activity unavailable'+(a.error?' ('+esc(a.error)+')':'')+'.';
    if(ks) ks.innerHTML=''; if(host) host.innerHTML='<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left">'+msg+'</div>';
    return;
  }
  if(meta) meta.textContent='synced '+esc(a.asOf);
  var od = a.open? Math.round(a.overduePct*100) : 0;
  ks.innerHTML=[
    {l:'Open Follow-ups', v:num(a.open), s:num(a.noDate)+' with no due date', cls:''},
    {l:'Overdue', v:num(a.overdue), s:od+'% of open', cls:(a.overdue>0?'down':'up')},
    {l:'Due Next 7 Days', v:num(a.dueSoon), s:'coming up', cls:(a.dueSoon>0?'flat':'')}
  ].map(function(c){ return '<div class="ms"><div class="l">'+c.l+'</div><div class="v '+c.cls+'">'+c.v+'</div><div class="s">'+c.s+'</div></div>'; }).join('');
  var owners=a.owners||[];
  if(!owners.length){ host.innerHTML='<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left">No open follow-ups.</div>'; return; }
  var body=owners.map(function(o){
    return '<tr><td>'+esc(o.name)+'</td><td class="v">'+num(o.open)+'</td><td class="v '+(o.overdue>0?'down':'')+'">'+num(o.overdue)+'</td><td class="v">'+num(o.dueSoon)+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  host.innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>Owner</th><th>Open</th><th>Overdue</th><th>Due 7d</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+body+'</tbody></table>';
}

function bdvPanel(){
  var b=DATA.bdVal; var ks=$('bdvKpis'), host=$('bdvChart');
  if(!b){ if(ks) ks.innerHTML=''; if(host) host.innerHTML='<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left">BD Validation Date column not found on Basis Master.</div>'; return; }
  ks.innerHTML=[
    {l:'Validated YTD', v:num(b.validatedYtd), s:'BD validations this year'},
    {l:'Coverage', v:Math.round(b.coveragePct*100)+'%', s:num(b.validatedOfCreated)+' of '+num(b.createdYtd)+' created'},
    {l:'Median Speed', v:(b.medianDays==null?'—':b.medianDays+'d'), s:'created → validated'}
  ].map(function(c){ return '<div class="ms"><div class="l">'+c.l+'</div><div class="v">'+c.v+'</div><div class="s">'+c.s+'</div></div>'; }).join('');
  var d=b.monthly||[]; var months=['J','F','M','A','M','J','J','A','S','O','N','D'];
  var W=360,H=150,padL=22,padR=8,padT=12,padB=24, n=12, gw=(W-padL-padR)/n;
  var max=Math.max.apply(null, d.concat([1]));
  var y=function(v){ return padT+(H-padT-padB)*(1-v/max); };
  var g='';
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var x0=padL+i*gw, bw=gw*0.6, xb=x0+(gw-bw)/2, hh=Math.max(0,(H-padB)-y(d[i]||0));
    g+='<rect x="'+xb+'" y="'+y(d[i]||0)+'" width="'+bw+'" height="'+hh+'" rx="2" fill="#E1251B"/>';
    if(d[i]) g+='<text x="'+(x0+gw/2)+'" y="'+(y(d[i])-3)+'" fill="#bbb" font-size="8.5" text-anchor="middle">'+d[i]+'</text>';
    g+='<text x="'+(x0+gw/2)+'" y="'+(H-padB+13)+'" fill="#9a9a9a" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">'+months[i]+'</text>';
  }
  host.innerHTML='<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">'+g+'</svg><div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left;margin-top:4px">BD validations per month (by validation date)</div>';
}

function funnelTable(){
  var f=DATA.funnel; var host=$('funnel');
  if(!host) return;
  if(!f){ host.innerHTML='<div class="pmeta" style="text-align:left">Bid funnel unavailable (ALL DATA / HP DATES sheet not found).</div>'; return; }
  var fm=$('funnelMeta'); if(fm) fm.textContent='matches Bid Pace · anchored '+esc(f.anchor);
  var byKey={}; (f.cols||[]).forEach(function(c){ byKey[c.key]=c; });
  var months=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  var mk=[]; for(var i=1;i<=12;i++) mk.push('m'+i);
  var ytd=byKey['ytd']||{}, prev=byKey['prev']||{};
  function paceCell(cur,pr){ if(!pr) return '<td class="v">—</td>'; var p=Math.round(cur/pr*100); return '<td class="v '+(p>=100?'up':'down')+'">'+p+'%</td>'; }
  function rowNum(label,fld,fmt){
    var cells=mk.map(function(k){ var c=byKey[k]||{}; return '<td class="v">'+fmt(c[fld]||0)+'</td>'; }).join('');
    return '<tr><td>'+label+'</td>'+cells+'<td class="v tot">'+fmt(ytd[fld]||0)+'</td><td class="v">'+fmt(prev[fld]||0)+'</td>'+paceCell(ytd[fld]||0,prev[fld]||0)+'</tr>';
  }
  function rowPct(label,numF,denF){
    var cells=mk.map(function(k){ var c=byKey[k]||{}; var d=c[denF]||0; return '<td class="v">'+(d?Math.round((c[numF]||0)/d*100)+'%':'—')+'</td>'; }).join('');
    var yd=ytd[denF]||0, pd2=prev[denF]||0;
    return '<tr class="pctrow"><td>'+label+'</td>'+cells+'<td class="v tot">'+(yd?Math.round((ytd[numF]||0)/yd*100)+'%':'—')+'</td><td class="v">'+(pd2?Math.round((prev[numF]||0)/pd2*100)+'%':'—')+'</td><td class="v">—</td></tr>';
  }
  var head='<tr><th>Stage &middot; by bid deadline</th>'+months.map(function(m){return '<th>'+m+'</th>';}).join('')+'<th class="tot">YTD '+esc(f.year)+'</th><th>YTD '+esc(f.prevYear)+'</th><th class="tot">Pace</th></tr>';
  var body=rowNum('Bid Invites Received','inv',num)
    +rowNum('Accepted to Bid Board','board',num)
    +rowPct('Accept Rate (of invites)','board','inv')
    +rowNum('Submitted','sub',num)
    +rowNum('Submitted $','subDol',fmtM)
    +rowNum('Hot Prospect Conversions','hp',num)
    +rowPct('HP Conversion (of submitted)','hp','sub');
  host.innerHTML='<table><thead>'+head+'</thead><tbody>'+body+'</tbody></table>';
}
function render(){ $('asof').textContent='As of '+esc(DATA.asOf); kpis(); oppChart(); gcChart(); bdmTable(); regionTable(); topGc(); newGc(); activityPanel(); bdvPanel(); funnelTable(); }
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
